name: DepositOne
summary: Internal platform for the operational tracking of deposit agreements and the viewing of analytics.
description: DepositOne keeps depositor cards, deposits and contracts in one place. Every deposit belongs to a depositor, every contract wraps a single deposit, and the repayment plan is derived from the deposit terms. The platform shows portfolio structure, cash flow by period and the schedule of upcoming returns.
author: Bogdan Vitriak
features: Registration and sign in protected by JWT
Depositor, deposit and contract cards with full create, read, update and delete
Search, sorting and paging performed by the database
Portfolio analytics with charts and cash flow reports
Repayment schedule derived from deposit terms
Fallback answers when a service is unavailable
